lens: Technical SEO engineer (schema.org graphs, Google policies on self-serving reviews and doorway pages)
reads: research/cedar-springs-teardown-blueprint.md (moved from the repo root at the seed commit)
deliverables: C6 @graph per page with @ids: HomeAndConstructionBusiness, WebSite, WebPage, Service, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage (semantic only), Article with author; areaServed 13 places, hasOfferCatalog 4 services; placeholders omitted; no Review/AggregateRating
og:locale en_CA, og:type website (article for guides), per-page OG image with fallback

check-seo.mjs rules: h1-count, title-meta (≤60 / ≤160, unique), double-encoding, alt-filename, slug-lint, sentence-case, canonical, repeated-text, decorative-duplicate, cross-area-duplicates ([data-shared] exempt), internal-links, breadcrumbs, time-format, technical
acceptance: A13#3: One responsive component per pattern; no duplicated DOM — verified by check-seo#repeated-text (no text node repeated in a page outside [data-shared]; one nav[aria-label=Main])
A13#4: Descriptive hand-written alt; alt="" for decorative — verified by check-seo#alt-filename
A13#5: One H1 per template; embedded blocks start at H2 — verified by check-seo#h1-count
A13#6: H1 on every index page — verified by check-seo#h1-present-on-hubs
A13#17: aria-hidden on decorative duplicates or render once — verified by check-seo#decorative-duplicate
A13#18: One OG card per page; website type; en_CA locale — verified by check-seo#og-tags
A13#19: Escape once at build; no double-encoding — verified by check-seo#double-encoding
A13#21: Slug linting — verified by check-seo#slug-lint
A13#29: HTTPS, consistent canonicals — verified by check-seo#canonical
A13#33: Proper case in HTML source — verified by check-seo#sentence-case
A13#35: 301 old duplicate URLs to new; one canonical per page — verified by check-seo#canonical-unique
C1.4: Internal linking (service↔municipality↔project) — verified by check-seo#internal-links
C6.1: One @id JSON-LD graph (business subtype, Service, BreadcrumbList, FAQPage optional, no Review/AggregateRating) — verified by unit/seo-graph.test#graph
C6.2: Title and meta description patterns and lengths — verified by check-seo#title-meta
C6.3: Social cards: en_CA, one OG image per template, og:type website — verified by og-cards#coverage
C6.6: Technical: sitemap, robots, self canonicals, _redirects, lang en-CA, build SEO checks — verified by check-seo#technical
P3#14: JSON-LD graph, OG per page, og:locale en_CA, lang en-CA — verified by check-seo#jsonld-graph
Unit tests snapshot the graph for home, a service, an area, a project and a guide
gates: cd $WT/site && node tools/dev-setup.mjs --devtools   # once it exists (W1 build); before that: tsc --typeRoots /opt/node-tools/node_modules/@types
node build.mjs --offline-images --out=$OUT && SITE_DIST=$OUT node tools/check-all.mjs --no-build [--strict-redirects from W1 ia on]
PORT=$PORT SITE_DIST=$OUT node node_modules/playwright/cli.js test --trace off
node tools/a11y.mjs --themes=dark,light --widths=320,1440 --motion=off,on   # once qa lands; until then axe via the global helper
verifierLens: Rich-results validator mindset: parse every JSON-LD block, check @id references resolve, look for invented values
portRule: builder = port; reviewer = port + 10; fixer = port + 20; evidence collector 4400
returns: {branch, head, base, files, gates, acceptance[], requests[]}
requests: .orchestra/requests/seo.md (never edit a file outside owns; describe the change there)
